# Pinned MoyaForge artifacts

These tarballs are built from `https://github.com/moyarich/moyaforge` at the revision recorded in `../moyaforge.sources.json` using the unmodified package build commands. Runtime dependencies remain declared by the upstream packages; npm records their integrity in the monorepo lockfile.

The artifacts contain the upstream package distribution and documentation. MoyaForge packages and registry components are MIT licensed. Source and license: https://github.com/moyarich/moyaforge . Use `npm run moyaforge:update --workspace=@moyarich/playground` to rebuild them. These files are intentionally tracked until public package releases are available.
